To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
enterprise architecture and business models are related and that this relation can be used to analyze enterprise architecture changes for their value to the business.
enterprise architecture changes are mirrored in business models and can be analyzed using business model-driven migration.
business models are useful to analyze the value of an architecture change and that the proposed method can be used for business model-driven migration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a method that supports the analysis of IT architecture change by means of business modeling.
the question how enterprise architecture management can support the development and evolution of a business model, and vice versa.
a method to relate business models to enterprise architectures and to use this relationship for architecture change management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach and method are useful in practice and may support business model-driven architecture management.
our approach and method provide the means to analyze the value of an architecture change by means of a business model.
the proposed method and approach is a promising approach to facilitate the analysis of IT change processes in relation to business models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the business model is an effective means of assessing the value of an enterprise architecture and that enterprise architecture is a valuable tool for implementing a business model.
we have provided a method that supports enterprise architects in the analysis of the business value of enterprise architecture changes.
enterprise architecture and business model are two sides of the same coin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
enterprise architecture can be used to analyze business model changes and that the proposed approach and method can support this analysis.

enterprise architects should not only consider enterprise architecture as a means of achieving the organization’s goals and objectives but also as a means of realizing the organization’s business models.
business models can be used as a lens to analyze the effects of enterprise architecture changes.
